GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 1 length Lead on fence, Held Together in front middle stages, got away at the 500m, led nearly 3 Lengths turning, kept going in Straight easing down from the 50m # always in control

Jumped well and Went Forward initially in tandem, established superiority and went out to lead 2.5 Lengths on fence, joined and challenged at 1050m, fought off challenger and went back out to lead 1 length past 800m, Held Together in front & led 1 length turning, Headed 120m, weakened to the line. [Stewards: Raced keenly middle stages. Rider was questioned re excessively slackening the tempo early. App. jockey advised it failed to come back when he restrained and when he took a tighter hold it dropped the bit and came back underneath him.] # led/faded last 150m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward quickly establishing a 4 Lengths lead, went clear and led 8 Lengths by the 1200m, came back to lead by 1 length turning, Headed Straightening Up and dropped off in straight. [Stewards: Rider reported she intended to lead however, it started racing keenly down the hill at 1400m and she was unable to travel at the desired tempo until 1000m. She added the extra early work was detrimental to its overall performance.] # went mad in front
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start DRIALLE commenced to race keenly down the hill at the 1400m & was unable to travel at the tempo she would have liked until approaching the 1000m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly then Went Forward to 1.5 Lengths Lead on fence, went 3-and-4 Lengths clear middle stages, led 3 Lengths turning, came back rounding turn, joined on Straightening Up , raced head'n'head to the line # lost in headbobber
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Blundered on jumping, ridden forward and led rail by 3 Lengths with a lap to go, Held Together in front middle stages, joint Lead at 1000m and again approaching turn, led 3 Lengths jointly turning, edge to a narrow Lead Straightening Up , kept going in Straight and held on in a headbobber # won in a headbobber
Jumped Fast Went Forward from Outside Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear same to straightening up challenged x 300m, # run ended 200m

Jumped very awkwardly then ridden positively & Went Forward to 3 Lengths Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 1.25 Lengths turning, Headed Straightening Up and Lost Ground in Straight # faded once headed
Jumped Well Outside Leader eq lead 600m eq lead home turn Hard Ridden 3rd Straightened Up last weakened badly final 300m # pace/very weak late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and shifted in and bumping Too Hot To Torque. Apprentice stated that, in his opinion, the heavy track conditions, together with the gelding's weight impost, were detrimental to its performance in today's event. A postrace veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , led but stayed Two Wide 700m, challenged and Headed soon after Straightening Up but he dug deep last 200m and fought race out strongly only going down by small margin # led/brave place

Jumped well went Straight to the front settling down just under a length Clear (1200m), Ridden Along Turn & into the Straight Quickly Under Pressure , headed before 200 fading to the line # led/headed 220

Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward to Lead 2 Lengths out of str, steadied Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear Joined x 600m, Under Pressure @ 400m, dueled to 50m then Couldn'T Go On and was weak once beat - # 50m too far
